entities.summary: Sergey Aleksandrovich Tolchinsky is a Russian professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing with Metallurg Magnitogorsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He has formerly played with the Carolina Hurricanes of the National Hockey League (NHL).
